name: alignment-review-prd
title: alignment review 提前暴露 PRD 结构门禁
description: 让 workloom_task_align 的 review 结果在不改变只读语义的前提下，提前返回 PRD 结构诊断（如 H1 缺失、骨架小节缺失或仍是 placeholder、open nodes 未收敛）以及 confirmBlockers/readyToConfirm，避免主会话直到 confirm 才发现 ## Notes 等必备小节在整文件重写时被漏掉；同步区分 missing section 与 unfilled placeholder 的诊断文案，并补齐资产契约与测试。
creator: northwang-lucky

check.summary: Phase 2.2 passed after independent implement-report verification and a dedicated check executor review. Verified the shared PRD structure classifier, review structureIssues/confirmBlockers/readyToConfirm contract, distinct missing-section and placeholder diagnostics, confirm aggregation and zero-write behavior, start/doctor reuse, DSH/Pi opaque projection, workflow/skill/eval/surface updates, and protocol v22 consistency. Check executor fixed one in-scope P2 formatting issue in task-store.test.js; main session independently reran git diff --check, pnpm lint, pnpm -r typecheck, pnpm -r build, core node tests (594 pass), adapter-dsh node tests (139 pass), and adapter-pi bun tests (188 pass), all green. LSP diagnostics on changed test lines were clean; stale core LSP module-resolution errors were contradicted by clean tsc. No commit, push, profile rsync, or dshweb restart occurred.

alignment.summary: Phase 1.1 alignment covered goal/value, scope and non-goals, environment and layering constraints, observable acceptance, UI/test-first applicability, test-first seams, review result shape and stable blocker codes, shared PRD classifier consumption across review/confirm/start/doctor, error aggregation order, readyToConfirm semantics, DSH/Pi adapter projection, workflow/skill/eval/surface/protocol-version asset updates, validation matrix, and deployment boundary.
